A1.justification: Both PDFs describe 3ViewSense and OrthoMind-3D. Their complete main texts, tables, figures, equations, and appendices are readable and can be matched across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, training-stage ablations, visual-feature probing, and three-view prompting experiments in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains original empirical evaluations and additionally reports a Direct QA control, MindCube-Tiny results, and external-benchmark case studies.

M1.justification: The OMS-to-VGR training pipeline, orthographic representations, GRPO objective, and strict/slack rewards remain unchanged. The reward paragraph is rewritten equivalently. Direct QA is an experimental control, not a revision to the proposed method.

E1.justification: CLeVR evaluation is removed and MindCube-Tiny is introduced, replacing compositional visual-question-answering coverage with spatial mental-model evaluation. The stage ablation also substitutes MindCube-Tiny for SPBench-SI. OrthoMind-3D and the other four external benchmarks remain.

E2.justification: New Table 4 evaluates a Direct QA comparator trained with final-answer supervision against view-guided reasoning. The named proprietary, specialized, and general-purpose comparison models in the main benchmark tables are retained.

E3.justification: The new Direct QA experiment controls training inputs, instances, and hyperparameters while varying supervision targets. MindCube-Tiny uses its full 1,040-example split without subsampling. Stated protocols for retained benchmarks and the main training budgets remain unchanged; revised scores alone do not establish additional protocol changes.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 adds a controlled ablation testing whether transfer benefits arise from view-guided reasoning rather than answer supervision alone. Appendix C.7 and Figure 14 add two external-benchmark case studies. Existing probing, prompting, training-stage, and RL-initialization analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions disclose the same data seed, 42, and retain the same statistical reporting practices. Neither introduces repeated-run estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests; the retained reward trajectories are not new uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Table 2 substantially revises external-benchmark results under unchanged stated protocols. SPBench-SI base/slack accuracies change from 27.1/54.2 to 22.2/25.4, and ViewSpatial from 33.5/72.9 to 35.5/37.1. SFT now trails the base model on all four retained external benchmarks. Two-stage SFT OrthoMind-3D ID/OOD results change from 71.0/48.5 in v1 Table 4 to 78.6/49.5 in v2 Table 5. MindCube-Tiny, Direct QA, and external qualitative results are added; CLeVR results are removed. These are reporting changes, without an explanation establishing their cause.

T1.justification: The probabilistic formulation, objectives, and mathematical conditions are retained. Appendix A preserves Definition A.1, Theorem A.2, its proof, and Corollary A.3 unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the spatial-interface diagnosis, OrthoMind-3D contribution, simulate-and-reason framework, and transfer claims. The introduction replaces its numerical transfer examples with MindCube-Tiny results, changing supporting evidence rather than the central contribution or claim scope.

C2.justification: The new Direct QA discussion distinguishes stronger dataset fitting from transferable reasoning. Section 5.1 replaces the emphasis on SPBench/ViewSpatial transfer and the CLeVR leakage caveat with an interpretation of gains across all five current external benchmarks. The limitations in v2 Section 6 already appeared in v1 Appendix D.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project repository link and an explicit Gemini image-generation model identifier in its reference entry. The existing prompts, implementation frameworks, hyperparameters, and training-data counts remain. The PDFs establish the new access pointer, not the repository's actual contents or availability.

R1.justification: v2 adds the Xu et al. Grouter and Gemini image-model references, replaces the Qwen3 technical-report citation with Qwen3-VL, and removes the CLeVR reference. Numerous other changes update publication metadata for existing works. The main positioning around structured orthographic reasoning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized reward and results rewrites, moves Appendix D into main-text Section 6, swaps the order of appendix response examples and reward analysis, and adds an Impact Statement. Conference front matter replaces the preprint notice. Most of the narrative and method exposition is retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds the Direct QA table and external-case Figure 14, changes benchmark-column labels, enlarges Figure 1, and relocates existing displays. The appendix response example and reward curves exchange order and figure numbers. Existing graphical content is otherwise retained.

improvement.justification: The matched-data Direct QA control and repository pointer are useful additions. However, the extensive Table 2 revisions under unchanged stated protocols are unexplained, leaving uncertain whether they correct earlier errors or reflect undocumented evaluation changes. The new Figure 14 SPBench example also reasons about a couch although its question asks about a pillow, weakening its claimed qualitative support. These unresolved issues prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
